name: Single-Scattering Differentiable Volume Rendering
definition: A differentiable renderer that reconstructs smoke density fields using a single-scattering assumption, enabling analytical gradient computation with respect to density ρ via the optical property κt(x) = σtρ(x).
summary: Single-Scattering Differentiable Volume Rendering reconstructs smoke density from multi-view images using single-scattering assumptions and analytical gradients, offering 50-100x speedups over Differential Ray Tracing by pre-computing view-independent radiance terms.
